001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.avaje;
002
003import java.lang.System.Logger;
004import java.util.ResourceBundle;
005
006import io.avaje.applog.AppLog;
007import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter;
008import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LoggerAPI;
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.RainbowGum;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.systemlogger.RainbowGumSystemLogger;
011import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
012
013/**
014 * Provides an Avaje logger to use RainbowGum global queue to avoid initialization issues.
015 */
016@ServiceProvider(AppLog.Provider.class)
017public class RainbowGumAppLog implements AppLog.Provider {
018
019        /**
020         * For service loader.
021         */
022        public RainbowGumAppLog() {
023        }
024
025        @Override
026        public Logger getLogger(String name) {
027                var gum = RainbowGum.getOrNull();
028                if (gum != null) {
029                        gum.config().loggerRegistry().registerLoggerName(LoggerAPI.Standard.AVAJE_APPLOG, name);
030                }
031                return RainbowGumSystemLogger.of(name, LogRouter.global());
032        }
033
034        @Override
035        public Logger getLogger(String name, ResourceBundle bundle) {
036                return getLogger(name);
037        }
038
039}
